text_blocks.snippet: Herpes simplex virus (HSV) is a common virus that can cause both oral and genital herpes. While there's no cure for HSV, antiviral medications can help manage outbreaks and reduce the risk of transmission. Treatment options vary depending on the type of HSV infection (oral or genital), the severity of symptoms, and individual patient factors.

list.title: Antiviral Medications:
list.snippet: These medications, such as acyclovir, valacyclovir, and famciclovir, are the cornerstone of HSV treatment. They can be administered orally or topically (for skin infections) and work by inhibiting the virus's replication.
